runSummary.stalePolicy: LIVE eligibility requires real source verification and link evidence. Existing LIVE items are never removed merely because a discovery run does not rediscover them.
runSummary.note: Real 14.9.2026 23:12 sweep across 12 source families. No new candidate cleared the current LIVE threshold. IKEA customer-services job 354106 remained publicly readable, while a second IKEA sales-assistant role 360724 was current but ranked lower because of retail/pallet handling. LinkedIn exposed Wolt Support Associate in Bratislava but requires minimum B2 English. Pretlak surfaced a senior Creative Strategist role in Bratislava/Prague, but seniority and content-strategy scope are a mismatch. Upwork produced fresh WooCommerce work, including a $100 gifting-store build with <5 proposals, but it still expects experienced development/portfolio evidence; the previously captured $50 live-shop plugin test remains the lower-friction exact asset match. Facebook produced 0 verified direct-post hits. No LIVE deletion or unsafe canonical replacement was performed.

developmentChanges.title: Candidate novelty fingerprint
developmentChanges.reason: Persist a compact fingerprint from company, normalized title, canonical URL and core scope so republished or lightly renamed jobs can be identified as refreshes rather than false new opportunities. This reduces duplicate review work while preserving stable IDs.

developmentChanges.title: Promotion-ready decay review
developmentChanges.reason: Track how many runs and days each promotion-ready candidate has remained outside LIVE, then force re-verification or downgrade when evidence ages. This prevents an ever-growing stale promotion-ready queue from consuming attention.
